rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=False, img_n_bf=1, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-1 ONBOARDING manduca_bilateral on re-split Breast-CT (train3600/val200/test200 seed20260703, per-iter train_n=400, score val=200) under HARD 20-min budget. Manduca 2009 proj-space bilateral w/ CT noise model: N=N0*exp(-P) -> Q=sqrt(N) (Anscombe) -> trainable bilateral on Q -> invert -> FBP(128 views) -> optional image bilateral tail; supervised L2 vs clean phantom. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: none (first iter of slug); nearest ref = Mayo manduca iter-1 hr=0.0598 at these paper-faithful defaults, and the sibling breast DD-UNet-supervised run (same split) clears FBP baseline trivially at hr~0.81. (2) Failure mode: N/A onboarding; goal = does Manduca proj-bilateral run on breast val=200 under 20-min budget and clear the 128-view sparse FBP baseline (hr>0)? (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline = paper-faithful CONFIG defaults (proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, manduca_N0=1e5=dataset i0, img_n_bf=1, ep=10). (4) HYPOTHESIS: the ~6-9 param Manduca bilateral trains stably on breast (finite val_score, comparison.png) and clears hr>0; but expect a MODEST hr (the noise model targets Poisson photon noise, while breast's dominant defect is 128-view STREAK aliasing, so the proj-bilateral on sqrt-counts is a weak lever here vs the DD-UNet). The image-domain bilateral tail (img_n_bf) is the reserved iter-2+ lever. (5) BUDGET: bilateral is ~6-9 params, far cheaper than the DD-UNet (which ran ep10 train_n=400 val=200 in 227s); ep10 fits well under 20 min (30-min sbatch wall). breast uses a single shared PYRO-NN projector (no per-sample-ps swap), FBP batched, val_chunk=10 fine. (6) Loop continues; iter-2 dispatched on landing. Reserved knobs for iters 2-N: img_n_bf (image-domain denoise depth, the primary lever mirroring Mayo bilateral-supervised), proj_sr, bf_d_w_ratio, epochs.
